    <style>
      @font-face {
        font-family: "FB Reforma";
        src: url("data:text/html;base64,") format("truetype");
        font-weight: normal;
        font-style: normal;
      }

      body {
        margin: 0;
        line-height: 1.5;
        color: #000;
        background-color: var(--Neutrals-White, #fff);
      }

      :root {
        --primary: #00458a;
        --white: rgb(255, 255, 255);
        --shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 2px 20px 0px;
      }

      *,
      *:after,
      *:before {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
      }

      html {
        font-size: 14px;
        -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
        -ms-text-size-adjust: 100%;
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
      }

      p,
      h1 {
        margin-block: 1rem;
      }

      ol {
        padding-inline-start: 1.5rem;
      }

      .top-banner::after {
        content: "";

        opacity: 0.4;
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: -1;
      }

      .max-width {
        max-width: 76rem;
        margin: auto;
        width: 100%;
      }

      h1 {
        color: var(--white);
      }

      .h1,
      h1 {
        font-size: 2.2rem;
      }

      .container {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 70px;
      }

      .row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .col-1,
      .col-2 {
        padding: 0.5rem;
      }
      .center {
        text-align: center;
      }
      img[id="logo"] {
        max-width: 100%;
      }

      .captcha-mid {
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0 auto;
        margin-bottom: 70px;
      }

      .selectedLanguage {
        position: relative;
        color: #00458a;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.36rem;
        height: 50px;
      }

      .selectedLanguageMobile {
        color: #00458a;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.36rem;
        height: 50px;
      }

      .languages {
        display: none;
        flex-direction: column;
        background-color: white;
        line-height: 3rem;
        box-shadow: "0 15px 30px 0 rgba(0; 0; 0; 0.15)";
        border-radius: 0.6rem;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0rem;
        min-width: 12rem;
        z-index: 999;
        top: 4.36rem;
      }

      .languagesMobile {
        display: none;
        flex-direction: column;
        background-color: white;
        line-height: 3rem;
        box-shadow: "0 15px 30px 0 rgba(0; 0; 0; 0.15)";
        border-radius: 0.6rem;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: absolute;
        left: 9rem;
        min-width: 12rem;
        z-index: 999;
        top: 49rem;
      }
      .languageItem {
        display: flex;
        padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
        justify-content: space-between;
        font-size: 1rem;
        align-items: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: #00458a;
        font-weight: 400;
        font-family: "arial";
        border-bottom: 0.1rem solid #e2e2e2;
        font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
      }

      .languageItemMobile {
        display: flex;
        padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
        justify-content: space-between;
        font-size: 1rem;
        align-items: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: #00458a;
        font-weight: 400;
        font-family: "arial";
        border-bottom: 0.1rem solid #e2e2e2;
        font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
      }

      .languageItem:hover {
        background-color: #d8f2fc;
      }
      .languageItemMobile:hover {
        background-color: #d8f2fc;
      }

      .mobileMenu {
        width: 100%;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
      }

      .menu {
        display: flex;
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 65px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }

      .menu > :nth-child(2) {
        margin-left: auto;
      }

      #he_selected_image {
        visibility: visible;
      }
      #en_selected_image {
        visibility: hidden;
      }
      #ar_selected_image {
        visibility: hidden;
      }
      #ru_selected_image {
        visibility: hidden;
      }

      #he_selected_imageMobile {
        visibility: visible;
      }
      #en_selected_imageMobile {
        visibility: hidden;
      }
      #ar_selected_imageMobile {
        visibility: hidden;
      }
      #ru_selected_imageMobile {
        visibility: hidden;
      }

      #currentLanguage,
      #currentLanguageMobile {
        /* font-weight: bold; */
        font-size: 1.29rem;
        font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
      }

      .selectedLanguageContainer,
      .selectedLanguageContainerMobile {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
      }

      .frame3 {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        /* justify-content: center; */
        align-items: center;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        gap: 16.03rem;
        cursor: default;
      }

      header {
        min-height: 3.57rem;
        width: 100%;
        padding: 0px 4.64rem;
        background-color: var(--white);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        /* position: fixed;
        z-index: 999; */
      }

      .frame2 {
        display: inline-flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 65px;
      }

      .frame1 {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 70px;
      }

      .robot {
        width: 240px;
        height: 210.124px;
        cursor: default;
      }

      .titlesContainer {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        /* gap: 20px; */
      }

      #title,
      #sub-title {
        color: var(--Primary-Blue, #00458a);
        text-align: center;
        font-feature-settings: "liga" off, "clig" off;
        font-size: 3.71rem;
        font-style: normal;
        font-weight: 400;
        line-height: normal;
        letter-spacing: 1.56px;
        /* font-family: "Fb Reforma"; */
      }

      #title {
        font-family: "Fb Reforma", sans-serif;
        font-weight: 400;
      }

      #sub-title {
        font-family: "Fb Reforma", sans-serif;
        font-weight: 600;
      }

      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .menu {
          display: none;
        }

        #title {
          font-size: 1.57rem;
          font-weight: 600;
        }

        #sub-title {
          font-size: 1.57rem;
        }

        .frame3 {
          gap: 4.64rem;
        }

        .selectedLanguageMobile {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: center;
        }
      }

      @media (min-width: 768px) {
        .mobileMenu {
          display: none;
        }
        .selectedLanguageMobile {
          display: none;
        }
        /* #mobileLanguages{
          display: none;
        } */
      }

      .nav {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        align-items: flex-end;
        gap: 50px;
        align-self: stretch;
        opacity: 0.24;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }

      .navItem {
        display: flex;
        height: 50px;
        padding: 5px 0px 2px 0px;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
      }

      .navItem:first-child {
        border-bottom: 3px solid #f9ba4d;
      }

      .navItemText {
        color: var(--Primary-Blue, #00458a);
        text-align: right;
        font-feature-settings: "liga" off, "clig" off;

        /* Navigation links */
        font-family: "Fb Reforma", sans-serif;

        font-size: 18px;
        font-style: normal;
        font-weight: 400;
        line-height: normal;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      }

      .searchSection {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
        opacity: 0.24;
      }

      .seperator {
        width: 2px; /* Width of the vertical line */
        height: 50%; /* Height of the vertical line */
        background-color: #f9ba4d; /* Color of the vertical line */
        margin: 0 2.14rem; /* Optional: Add some horizontal margin */
        display: flex;
        /* opacity: 0.24; */
      }

      .searchSectionAndLang {
        display: flex;
      }

      .hamburger {
        opacity: 0.24;
      }

  <body onload="handleLangDirection()">
    <script type="text/javascript">
      function handleLangDirection() {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("dir", "rtl");
      }
      handleLangDirection();
      const translations = {
        he: {
          title: "לפני שנעביר אותך לאתר,",
          subTitle: "חשוב לנו לוודא שאינך רובוט",
          botBehavior:
            "העמוד שחיפשת מיד יעלה, אבל לפני זה יש לאשר שאינך רובוט.",
          noteBold: "הערה:",
          noteRegular: "",
          captchaSolve:
            "* אם ניסית לגשת לאתר זה באמצעות רשת פרטית/פרוקסי אנונימית, יש להשבית אותה ולנסות לגשת שוב לאתר לאחר מכן.",
          listItemTwo: "",
        },
        en: {
          title: ",Before entering the website",
          subTitle: "we need to make sure you are not a robot",
          botBehavior:
            "The page you were looking for will load shortly, but first; we need to confirm that you are not a robot.",
          noteBold: "Note:",
          noteRegular: "",
          captchaSolve:
            "* If you are trying to access this site using a private network/anonymous proxy please disable it and try to access the site again.",
          listItemTwo: "",
        },
        ru: {
          title: ",Перед тем, как переадресовать Вас на сайт",
          subTitle: "нам важно убедиться в том, что Вы не робот",
          botBehavior:
            "Страница, которую Вы искали, сейчас появится, но сначала нужно проверить, что Вы не робот.",
          noteBold: "Примечание:",
          noteRegular: "",
          captchaSolve:
            "* Если Вы пытались зайти на сайт через частную сеть / анонимный прокси-сервер, следует закрыть ее и затем снова зайти на сайт.",
          listItemTwo: "",
        },
        ar: {
          title: "قبل تحويلك إلى الموقع،",
          subTitle: "علينا التأكد من أنك لست روبوتا",
          botBehavior:
            "ستظهر الصفحة التي كنت تبحث عنها على الفور، ولكن قبل ذلك يجب عليك التأكيد على أنك لست روبوتًا.",
          noteBold: "ملاحظة:",
          noteRegular: "",
          captchaSolve:
            "* إذا حاولت الوصول إلى هذا الموقع باستخدام شبكة خاصة/وكيل مجهول، فيرجى تعطيله ومحاولة الوصول إلى الموقع مرة أخرى بعد ذلك.",
          listItemTwo: "",
        },
      };

      function changeRussionWidth(currentLanguage) {
        if (currentLanguage === "ru") {
          const titlesContainer = document.querySelector(".titlesContainer");
          if (window.matchMedia("(max-width: 768px)").matches) {
            titlesContainer.style.width = "85%";
          } else {
            titlesContainer.style.width = ""; // Reset width if not mobile
          }
        } else {
          const titlesContainer = document.querySelector(".titlesContainer");
          titlesContainer.style.width = ""; // Reset width if language is not Russian
        }
      }

      const onSelectedLanguageOver = () => {
        const languagesElement = document.getElementById("languages");
        languagesElement.style.display = "flex";
      };
      const onSelectedLanguageOverMobile = () => {
        const languagesElementMobile =
          document.getElementById("languagesMobile");
        languagesElementMobile.style.display = "flex";
      };

      const onSelectedLanguageLeave = () => {
        const languagesElement = document.getElementById("languages");
        languagesElement.style.display = "none";
      };

      const onSelectedLanguageLeaveMobile = () => {
        const languagesElementMobile =
          document.getElementById("languagesMobile");
        languagesElementMobile.style.display = "none";
      };

      const handleLanguageSelection = (selectedLanguage) => {
     

        const languagesElement = document.getElementById("languages");
        languagesElement.style.display = "none";

        const selectedImage = document.getElementById(
          `${selectedLanguage}_selected_image`
        );
        selectedImage.style.visibility = "visible";

        const selectedImages =
          document.getElementsByClassName("selected_image");

        const otherLanguages = Array.from(selectedImages)
          .filter(
            (selectedImage) =>
              selectedImage.id !== `${selectedLanguage}_selected_image`
          )
          .map((selectedImage) => (selectedImage.style.visibility = "hidden"));

        const currentLanguageElement =
          document.getElementById("currentLanguage");
        currentLanguageElement.innerText = selectedLanguage.toUpperCase();

        const titleElement = document.getElementById("title");
        titleElement.innerText = translations[selectedLanguage].title;

        const subTitleElement = document.getElementById("sub-title");
        subTitleElement.innerText = translations[selectedLanguage].subTitle;

        // const captchaSolveElement = document.getElementById("captchaSolve");
        // captchaSolveElement.innerText =
        //   translations[selectedLanguage].captchaSolve;

        if (selectedLanguage === "he" || selectedLanguage === "ar") {
          titleElement.setAttribute("direction", "rtl");
          subTitleElement.setAttribute("direction", "rtl");
        } else if (selectedLanguage === "en" || selectedLanguage === "ru") {
          titleElement.setAttribute("direction", "ltr");
          subTitleElement.setAttribute("direction", "ltr");
        }


      };

      function scrollToBottom() {
        window.scrollTo({
          top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight,
          behavior: "smooth",
        });
      }

      const handleLanguageSelectionMobile = (selectedLanguage) => {
        const languagesElement = document.getElementById("languagesMobile");
        languagesElement.style.display = "none";

        const selectedImage = document.getElementById(
          `${selectedLanguage}_selected_imageMobile`
        );
        selectedImage.style.visibility = "visible";

        const selectedImages = document.getElementsByClassName(
          "selected_imageMobile"
        );

        const otherLanguages = Array.from(selectedImages)
          .filter(
            (selectedImage) =>
              selectedImage.id !== `${selectedLanguage}_selected_imageMobile`
          )
          .map((selectedImage) => (selectedImage.style.visibility = "hidden"));

        const currentLanguageElementMobile = document.getElementById(
          "currentLanguageMobile"
        );
        currentLanguageElementMobile.innerText = selectedLanguage.toUpperCase();

        const titleElement = document.getElementById("title");
        titleElement.innerText = translations[selectedLanguage].title;

        const subTitleElement = document.getElementById("sub-title");
        subTitleElement.innerText = translations[selectedLanguage].subTitle;

        changeRussionWidth(selectedLanguage);
      };
    </script>
